observation.command:
ps aux | grep -E "run-executor|nx.js|vite" | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2}' | xargs -r kill 2>/dev/null; sleep 5
for p in 39001 39002 39003; do curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 2 -w "$p: %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:$p/ 2>/dev/null || echo "$p: closed"; done
echo "=== ports.json / nginx still consistent? ==="; cat /workspace/.urbo/workspace/ports.json; grep -oE "172\.[0-9.]+:[0-9]+" /workspace/.urbo/workspace/nginx.conf | sort -u
free -m | sed -n '2p' | awk '{print "available="$6"MB"}'
